title.zh: 东方红一号展览复制品

alt.zh: 展厅中一颗带细长天线的多面体卫星悬挂在蓝色背景前，金属表面反射着顶灯的光。
alt.en: A faceted satellite replica hangs against a blue exhibition wall. Thin antennas extend sideways and the metal faces reflect the overhead light.

note.zh: 摄于 2011 年呼和浩特航天科技展。图中是复制品，不是 1970 年升空的卫星。
note.en: Photographed at a space technology exhibition in Hohhot in 2011. This is a replica, not the satellite launched in 1970.

edits.zh: 裁为 16:9，轻微调整色调，缩放并转为 WebP。
edits.en: Cropped to 16:9, lightly tone-adjusted, resized and encoded as WebP.

title.zh: 文昌，长征五号遥八转运
title.en: Long March 5 Y8 rollout at Wenchang

alt.zh: 白色火箭与橙色转运平台直立在林地间的道路上，远处可见水面和海岸。
alt.en: A white rocket stands on an orange mobile platform on a route through low coastal woodland.

note.zh: 本次嫦娥六号任务的长征五号遥八。画面记录的是发射前垂直转运，不是点火瞬间。
note.en: The Long March 5 Y8 assigned to Chang’e 6. This pre-launch rollout is not a picture of liftoff.

launch.author: 中国新闻社 / China News Service

edits.zh: 沿用署名文件页提供的节目截帧，裁为 16:9，轻微调整色调，转为 WebP。
edits.en: Based on the credited Commons video still, cropped to 16:9, lightly tone-adjusted and encoded as WebP.

alt.zh: 以地球弧面为背景的空间站渲染图。白色舱段在画面中央相连，深蓝色太阳翼向上下两侧伸展。
alt.en: In a rendering above Earth’s curved horizon, white modules meet at the center of the station while blue solar wings extend above and below.

note.zh: 2022 年初公开论文中的建成构型渲染，用于识别舱段关系，不是在轨实拍。
note.en: An early-2022 research publication illustrated the planned completed configuration. This is a rendering, not an in-orbit photograph.

edits.zh: 裁为 16:9，轻微调整色调，缩放并转为 WebP。
edits.en: Cropped to 16:9, lightly tone-adjusted, resized and encoded as WebP.

title.zh: 贵州平塘，中国天眼 FAST

alt.zh: 巨大的银色碗状反射面嵌在绿色群山间，周围分布着支撑塔与缆索。
alt.en: A vast silver dish sits in a hollow among green mountains, surrounded by support towers and cables.

note.zh: 贵州平塘 FAST 现场照片，摄于 2025 年 8 月；不是 2020 年验收活动照片。
note.en: Photographed at FAST, Pingtang, in August 2025. This does not depict the 2020 acceptance review.

edits.zh: 裁为 16:9，轻微调整色调，缩放并转为 WebP。
edits.en: Cropped to 16:9, lightly tone-adjusted, resized and encoded as WebP.
